question: if G2's judging quantity becomes m_spec with an absolute floor, does the gate refuse the write that crowds the store while keeping the three P1b legacy verdicts (replace admit, new admit, copy refuse) intact?
criterion_change: G2: median(1 - nearest) must not drop by more than 0.002  ->  m_spec (occupied-key nearest - second, self excluded) must stay >= floor

F0_spec_floor_as_absolute.source: SPEC §5 P3-A: 0.06863 - 0.002, reused as an absolute floor
F0_spec_floor_as_absolute.expectation: unusable: the baseline itself is 0.06863, so any new direction lands below it

F1_collapse_line.source: growth design S-B collapse line (existing constant, independent of P3)
F1_collapse_line.expectation: no crossing on 8/16 (min 0.033074); 64/128 baseline 0.019988 is already below it

F2_half_baseline.source: 0.5 x F1 baseline 0.06863, rule 'the read margin may be halved, not quartered'
F2_half_baseline.expectation: crossed by the 5th P3 append (0.033074); disclosed coincidence, not the basis of the verdict

sanity_cases_required_per_floor.S1_replace_admitted: policy=replace on an occupied slot must be published
sanity_cases_required_per_floor.S2_new_admitted: append of a key not in the store must be published
sanity_cases_required_per_floor.S3_copy_refused: append of a byte-identical key must be refused

rungs.low_8_16: six sequential appends; report m_spec trajectory and the first crossing
rungs.high_64_128: one append; report whether the exit changes vs P3's no_direction
rungs.fill_112_128: one append; no_capacity must still win (h = 0.117188 < 0.125)

untouched: every threshold except the G2 quantity itself

discipline.watchdog: abort after 60 s without a new reading (launcher)
